# Phase D source/provenance register — 2026-10-05

Manufacturer documents govern; no third-party PCB was inspected/copied and no upstream source was modified. All datasheets are **referenced**; the C/C2 functional blocks are **adapted into our schematic**, with the explicitly selected C3 input-FET correction. Manufacturer copyrights remain; no open redistribution license is claimed for datasheets. Required attribution: keep manufacturer, title, URL and revision below. Inherited source registers remain unmodified.

The dummy-load footprint is a project-authored pair of exposed copper solder pads, no third-party source; it has no installed component cost. Copper/test-pad ratings and strain relief must be qualified with layout/harness. Manufacturer source provenance does not make any untested electrical behavior validated. Dated supplier offers are inherited as planning evidence, not refreshed stock or buying authorization.
